title: Modeling Euro Area Benchmark Rates After the End of LIBOR
affiliations: University of Perugia, University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: Modeling Euro Area Benchmark Rates After the End of LIBOR

publicationDetails.journalName: CEIS: Centre for Economic & International Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We adopt an affine short-rate model for the contemporaneous evolution of the term structures based on EURIBOR and on eSTR. The model is based on the observation that the risk-free rate follows a constant trajectory and moves only at deterministic times (depending on the European Central Bank meetings). We calibrate the model using Kalman filtering on a panel of term structure zero rates and compare its performances to the dynamic version of the Nelson-Siegel model, both in-and out-of-sample. The model is able to reproduce some common features of the term structure dynamics, such as the "snake" shaped term structure volatility and the fact that the volatility increases in periods containing the meeting dates. We analyze the sensitivity of the eSTR term structure to variations in monetary policy expectations and apply the model to estimate the level and the probability distribution of the future rates, and to show how to compute the fallback risk of a ongoing contract in case EURIBOR would be replaced by eSTR.

AI.tldr: 本文采用仿射短期利率模型研究EURIBOR和eSTR收益率曲线的同期演化。模型假设无风险利率在确定时间点（欧洲央行会议）发生变化，使用卡尔曼滤波校准，并与动态Nelson-Siegel模型比较。模型能再现收益率曲线波动的"蛇形"特征，并应用于估计未来利率水平和概率分布，以及计算EURIBOR被eSTR替代时的风险。
AI.research_question: 如何建模EURIBOR和eSTR收益率曲线的同期演化，并评估EURIBOR被eSTR替代的风险？
AI.motivation: 随着欧洲央行推进利率基准改革，需要理解EURIBOR向eSTR过渡的动力学特征和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仿射短期利率模型，假设无风险利率在确定时间点（欧洲央行会议）发生变化。
AI.method: 使用卡尔曼滤波对期限结构零利率面板进行模型校准，并与动态Nelson-Siegel模型进行样本内和样本外比较。
AI.findings: 模型能再现期限结构波动的"蛇形"特征，会议日期期间波动率增加；eSTR期限结构对货币政策预期变化敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于确定时间点利率变化的仿射短期利率模型，改进了对收益率曲线动态特征的建模能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 可用于估计未来利率水平和概率分布，计算EURIBOR被eSTR替代时的风险，为金融机构风险管理提供工具。

reference: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 25-20
title: How China Collateralizes
affiliations: Georgetown University Law Center, Georgetown University Law Center, Kiel Institute for the World Economy, Kiel Institute for the World Economy - IFW, AidData and Kiel Institute for the World Economy

detail.title: How China Collateralizes

publicationDetails.detailsText: Peterson Institute for International Economics Working Paper No. 25-20
publicationDetails.journalName: Peterson Institute for International Economics (PIIE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper is the first comprehensive analysis of the secured lending practices of Chinese creditors in emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs). We present a new dataset and detailed case studies of collateralized public and publicly guaranteed (PPG) loans from Chinese state-owned institutions in EMDEs between 2000 and 2021. Almost half of China's total PPG loan portfolio in EMDEs is effectively collateralized-amounting to $420 billion in collateralized debt across 57 countries. We document that Chinese lenders use techniques adapted from export and project finance to build multi-layered legal safety nets, which help ensure that risky EMDE loans will be repaid. As security, they use liquid, easily accessible assets, such as cash in bank accounts located in China. They rarely take infrastructure project assets as collateral, but often rely for repayment on established commodity revenue streams unrelated to the project. Typically, EMDE governments and state-owned enterprises commit to route foreign currency proceeds from commodity sales through bank accounts controlled by the lender. The cash balances in these accounts can be very large; in low-income, commodity-exporting countries, they average more than 20 percent of annual PPG debt service to all external creditors. The same revenue source can secure multiple successive borrowings over many years. Our findings reveal a previously undocumented pattern of revenue ring-fencing, where a significant share of commodity export receipts never reaches the exporting countries. Revenues routed overseas secure priority repayment for the creditor; they remain out of public sight and largely beyond the borrower's reach until the secured debts are repaid. These findings raise new concerns about debt transparency, fiscal management, fiscal autonomy, and the quality of macroeconomic surveillance, particularly in commodity-exporting EMDEs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面分析了中国债权人在新兴市场和发展中经济体的担保贷款实践，揭示了4200亿美元担保债务的规模，以及通过多层法律安全网和收入隔离机制确保贷款偿还的模式。
AI.research_question: 中国债权人在新兴市场和发展中经济体的担保贷款实践如何运作？其规模和特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 填补对中国在EMDEs担保贷款实践研究的空白，揭示其对债务透明度、财政管理和宏观经济监管的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于出口融资和项目融资理论，分析中国债权人如何构建多层法律安全网来管理EMDEs贷款风险。
AI.method: 使用新的数据集和详细案例研究，分析2000-2021年间中国国有机构在57个EMDEs的担保公共和公共担保贷款。
AI.findings: 中国在EMDEs的PPG贷款组合中近一半（4200亿美元）有担保；使用流动性资产作为抵押品；依赖商品收入流而非项目资产；建立收入隔离机制，商品出口收入直接流向债权人控制的账户。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统揭示了中国在EMDEs的担保贷款模式，提出了收入隔离概念，丰富了国际贷款风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了债务透明度问题，对EMDEs的财政管理和宏观经济监管提出警示，为政策制定者和监管机构提供重要参考。

title: Institutions and bank intermediation: The joint role of state capacity and civil liberties
affiliations: Universitas Indonesia and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Institutions and bank intermediation: The joint role of state capacity and civil liberties
detail.abstract: We examine the effects of state capacity and civil liberties on bank intermediation, measured by the banks’ ability to generate liquidity in the economy. Theory suggests that a strong state that upholds civil liberties promotes economic activity. Intensified economic activities, in turn, increase the demand for financial services and encourage banks to create liquidity in the economy. We investigate this hypothesis by testing two possible channels. First, equal power shared between the state and the people promotes market trust, which reduces information asymmetries and curbs excessive risk-taking, thereby enhancing financial intermediation efficiency. Second, a capable state in a democratic setting is more likely to undertake reforms and implement optimal regulatory policies that are favorable for the banking sector. Our findings confirm the presence of both channels, offering new insights into the significant effect of political institutions on the banking sector.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了国家能力和公民自由对银行中介的影响，发现强大的国家能力和公民自由通过促进市场信任和优化监管政策两个渠道，显著提升银行创造流动性的能力。
AI.research_question: 国家能力和公民自由如何影响银行中介（即银行创造流动性的能力）？
AI.motivation: 理论上，强大的国家能力和公民自由能够促进经济活动，而经济活动增加会提升对金融服务的需求，从而鼓励银行创造流动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学和政治经济学理论，强调国家能力与公民自由的平衡对经济活动的促进作用。
AI.method: 实证研究，通过检验两个可能的影响渠道：市场信任渠道和监管政策渠道。
AI.findings: 研究证实了两个渠道的存在：1）国家与人民权力平衡促进市场信任，减少信息不对称和过度风险承担；2）民主环境下的强国家更可能实施有利于银行业的改革和最优监管政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了政治制度对银行业影响的新见解，深化了对国家能力与公民自由相互作用机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善银行中介效率的具体路径，强调平衡国家能力与公民自由的重要性。

title: Household Vulnerability and Welfare Dynamics in Post-Conflict South Sudan: A Cross-Sectional Econometric Analysis Authors
affiliations: Kampala International University and Gambella University

detail.title: Household Vulnerability and Welfare Dynamics in Post-Conflict South Sudan: A Cross-Sectional Econometric Analysis Authors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I hereby declare that there are no conflicts of interest related to the research, authors, or publication of this article
declarations.funderStatement: No financial, personal, or private relationship has influenced this article

detail.abstract: This study examines the determinants of household welfare in post-conflict South Sudan using cross-sectional econometric analysis of 3,550 households across six states and 50 enumeration areas in 2015. In a context where over 80% of the population lives in poverty following decades of conflict, understanding vulnerability-welfare relationships becomes critical for effective policy intervention. Employing state fixed effects models with cluster-robust standard errors, we identify statistically significant vulnerability effects on household welfare outcomes, with vulnerable households experiencing 10.97 percentage points lower welfare scores compared to non-vulnerable households (t-statistic = 31.98). The analysis reveals important asset-vulnerability interactions, with the negative impact of vulnerability diminishing as household asset levels increase, suggesting compound disadvantages for asset-poor vulnerable households. Robustness checks, including bootstrap validation, alternative clustering approaches, and different welfare measures, confirm the consistency of core findings across specifications. Policy targeting simulations demonstrate potential efficiency gains of 20% through improved welfare-based targeting mechanisms compared to current vulnerability-based approaches, with optimal targeting achieving 100% efficiency at 10% coverage versus 85.7% for current methods. Heterogeneous effects analysis reveals that vulnerability impacts vary significantly across asset groups, with high-asset households showing the strongest vulnerability effects. These findings provide crucial insights for social protection policy design in fragile state contexts, particularly regarding the optimal targeting of limited resources to maximize welfare improvements among the most disadvantaged populations. They also offer a methodological template for extracting policy value from single-year cross-sectional data in challenging environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过南苏丹3550户家庭的横截面计量分析，发现脆弱性对家庭福利有显著负面影响（福利得分降低10.97个百分点），且这种影响随资产水平上升而减弱。政策模拟显示基于福利的瞄准机制比当前基于脆弱性的方法效率提高20%。
AI.research_question: 冲突后南苏丹家庭福利的决定因素是什么？脆弱性与福利之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: 南苏丹80%以上人口生活在贫困中，理解脆弱性与福利关系对有效政策干预至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 脆弱性-福利关系理论，资产-脆弱性相互作用理论
AI.method: 横截面计量分析，采用州固定效应模型和聚类稳健标准误，样本为2015年6个州50个枚举区的3550户家庭
AI.findings: 脆弱性显著降低家庭福利（10.97个百分点），资产水平越高，脆弱性负面影响越小；基于福利的瞄准机制效率比脆弱性瞄准高20%
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了脆弱性与资产水平的交互作用机制，为脆弱国家背景下的社会保护政策设计提供理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了政策瞄准效率改进方案（20%效率提升），为有限资源的最优分配提供了实证支持

title: Predicting Corporate Default Using Financial Ratios and Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis
affiliations: University of Miami - Department of Finance, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Predicting Corporate Default Using Financial Ratios and Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis

keywords.keywords: Corporate DefaultAccounting Ratios Machine Learning Debt Covenants Cost-of-Debt

detail.abstract: Using various machine learning and standard accounting- and market-based financial ratios, we predict corporate default across different time horizons. We find similar specificity and recall metrics across all methodologies, with XGBoost slightly outperforming the rest of the methods. Contrary to Logistic Regression the rest of the methodologies in this paper identify small subsets of ratios as important for predicting default, e.g., Debt Ratio, Interest Coverage, Price-to-Earnings, and Net Profit. We observe a decoupling between financial ratios that are significant out-of-sample default predictors according to the machine learning algorithms and those that are included in debt covenants or that can explain the cost of debt in-sample. These findings suggest that creditors should update their baseline approach to writing debt contracts, i.e., specifying interest rates and debt covenants that monitor financial ratios, by incorporating information from financial ratios that are important out-of-sample default predictors according to machine learning approaches.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用机器学习和传统财务比率预测企业违约，发现XGBoost表现最佳，机器学习方法识别出少数关键财务比率作为违约预测指标，但这些指标与债务契约中使用的比率存在差异，建议债权人更新债务合同制定方法。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习和财务比率预测企业违约？机器学习识别的重要财务比率与债务契约中使用的比率有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统债务合同制定方法可能未充分利用机器学习识别的重要违约预测指标，需要探索更有效的违约预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业违约预测理论、机器学习预测模型、财务比率分析理论
AI.method: 使用多种机器学习算法（包括XGBoost、逻辑回归等）和标准会计及市场财务比率，在不同时间跨度上预测企业违约
AI.findings: 1. 所有方法在特异性和召回率方面表现相似，XGBoost略优；2. 机器学习方法识别出少数关键财务比率（债务比率、利息覆盖率、市盈率、净利润）；3. 机器学习识别的重要预测指标与债务契约中使用的比率存在脱节
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证机器学习在企业违约预测中的有效性；2. 揭示传统债务契约制定与机器学习预测之间的理论差距；3. 为财务风险预测理论提供新的实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为债权人提供更准确的违约预测工具；2. 建议更新债务合同制定方法，纳入机器学习识别的重要财务比率；3. 优化利率设定和债务契约监控机制

title: When Swords Need Words: Military Unification and Pro-religion Rule
affiliations: Fudan University - Department of Economics, Fudan University and Renmin University of China

detail.title: When Swords Need Words: Military Unification and Pro-religion Rule
detail.abstract: During the 1,500 years before the Industrial Revolution, Eurasia witnessed divergent religious trajectories: Western Europe developed independent religious authority, while China maintained state-dominated religion. We propose that fragmentation-driven warfare prompts rulers to promote religion for legitimacy. Evidence from Imperial China demonstrates that emperors pursuing military unification were significantly more likely to adopt pro-religion policies, with legitimacy-deficient rulers showing particularly strong adoption of this strategy. These findings provide suggestive evidence that Europe's prolonged polycentrism fostered stronger religious institutions, offering a new perspective on the East-West Great Divergence.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了工业革命前1500年间欧亚大陆宗教轨迹的分歧：西欧发展出独立的宗教权威，而中国维持国家主导的宗教。研究发现，分裂驱动的战争促使统治者通过推广宗教来获取合法性，特别是在中国统一战争期间，合法性不足的统治者更倾向于采取亲宗教政策。
AI.research_question: 为什么工业革命前1500年间，欧亚大陆出现了不同的宗教发展轨迹？什么因素导致了西欧独立宗教权威和中国国家主导宗教的分歧？
AI.motivation: 理解东西方大分流（Great Divergence）的根源，特别是宗教制度在其中的作用，为解释欧洲和中国的不同发展路径提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政治分裂与宗教制度发展的理论框架，认为分裂驱动的战争会促使统治者利用宗教来增强统治合法性。
AI.method: 使用中国帝国时期的历史证据，分析追求军事统一的皇帝与宗教政策之间的关系，特别关注合法性不足统治者的行为模式。
AI.findings: 追求军事统一的皇帝显著更可能采取亲宗教政策，合法性不足的统治者对这种策略的采用尤为强烈。
AI.theory_contributions: 为东西方大分流提供了新的解释视角，强调欧洲长期多中心主义促进了更强宗教制度的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解宗教与政治权力的历史互动模式，为当代宗教政策制定提供历史借鉴。

title: How does an active secondary stock market enhance total factor productivity of non-listed enterprises? Evidence from China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How does an active secondary stock market enhance total factor productivity of non-listed enterprises? Evidence from China
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the stock market can enhance the total factor productivity (TFP) of non-listed enterprises. We propose that increased stock liquidity of listed companies promotes TFP growth in non-listed enterprises through three channels: (i) an information mechanism, by facilitating learning from investors' assessments of leading innovations; (ii) a financing mechanism, by mitigating financing constraint effects; and (iii) a governance mechanism, by alleviating principal-agent conflicts. These channels enhance the decision-making capabilities of non-listed enterprises, enabling them to better follow leading innovations and develop complementary technologies. Consequently, this mitigates innovation imbalance within the industry and ultimately boosts TFP growth. Empirical results corroborate the information and governance channels, but not the financing channel. This study provides evidence that the stock market generates positive externalities for the productivity growth of non-listed enterprises.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现股票市场流动性通过信息和治理机制提升非上市企业的全要素生产率，而非融资机制。
AI.research_question: 股票市场能否提升非上市企业的全要素生产率？
AI.motivation: 探讨股票市场对非上市企业生产率的溢出效应，揭示资本市场的外部性作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息机制、融资机制、治理机制三个理论渠道
AI.method: 实证研究方法
AI.findings: 股票流动性通过信息机制（学习投资者对领先创新的评估）和治理机制（缓解代理冲突）提升非上市企业TFP，但未发现融资机制的证据
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了股票市场对非上市企业生产率影响的三个理论机制，丰富了资本市场外部性理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解股票市场对实体经济的溢出效应提供了实证证据，有助于政策制定者更好地评估资本市场改革的影响

title: Scenario dynamics of degrowth under capitalist power
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Scenario dynamics of degrowth under capitalist power
detail.abstract: This article develops a framework for analyzing degrowth futures through the lens of Capital as Power (CasP). It translates CasP’s account of accumulation—organized through capitalization, sabotage, and state–capital entanglement—into a causal loop architecture. This approach clarifies how degrowth transformations interact with capitalist power through distinct feedback dynamics. Four scenarios are examined: (1) sabotaged transition, where degrowth initiatives are redirected to sustain accumulation; (2) post-growth accumulation, where reduced aggregate growth remains compatible with scarcity-based profits; (3) contested transformation, where degrowth confronts capital and sparks escalating conflict; and (4) systemic reordering, where confidence in capitalization unravels and capitalist order destabilizes. The analysis shows that reduced growth does not automatically weaken dominant capital, as stagnation and scarcity can sustain differential accumulation. For degrowth, this highlights that futures must be conceived as transformations of power relations: constraining the routes through which dominant capital increases its relative power, undermining the restrictions imposed on alternatives, and challenging the confidence capitalists have in the continuity of the order they rule. Degrowth futures must therefore be understood as struggles over the enforcement or destabilization of capitalist power.

AI.tldr: 本文通过资本即权力(CasP)视角分析去增长未来，构建了因果循环框架，揭示了去增长转型与资本主义权力之间的四种互动情景，强调去增长必须理解为权力关系的转变而不仅仅是经济增长的减少。
AI.research_question: 去增长转型如何与资本主义权力结构相互作用？去增长未来如何影响资本积累的动态？
AI.motivation: 理解去增长转型与资本主义权力关系的复杂互动，澄清经济增长减少并不自动削弱主导资本权力的现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本即权力(CasP)理论框架，强调资本积累通过资本化、破坏和国家-资本纠缠来组织。
AI.method: 构建因果循环架构，分析四种去增长情景：被破坏的转型、后增长积累、有争议的转型、系统性重组。
AI.findings: 经济增长减少并不自动削弱主导资本，停滞和稀缺可以维持差异积累；去增长必须理解为权力关系的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CasP理论转化为因果循环框架，阐明去增长与资本主义权力的反馈动态；提出了四种去增长转型情景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为去增长运动提供战略指导，强调必须限制主导资本增加相对权力的途径，挑战资本家对其统治秩序连续性的信心。

title: Does Law Codification Bring the Disadvantaged into the Legal System?
affiliations: University of Oxford

detail.title: Does Law Codification Bring the Disadvantaged into the Legal System?
detail.abstract: Does the codification of law lead disadvantaged groups to make more use of the legal system? I address this question by studying a natural experiment in Prussia. In 1794, King Frederick sought to empower the masses by harmonizing society’s many rules, orders, and laws into a clean legal code, which could be understood by all citizens. Using archival sentencing data, I show that codification led underrepresented groups to sue more frequently and to focus their lawsuits on issues closely linked to their preferences. In particular, women and non-aristocrats became more likely to sue on economic and family-related grounds, respectively. Women also became more likely to win in court. To explain this finding, I show that codification made sentences both more concise and easier to understand, thus opening the legal system to the disadvantaged.

AI.tldr: 普鲁士法律法典化使弱势群体（特别是女性和非贵族）更频繁地使用法律系统，并专注于与其偏好相关的诉讼，且女性胜诉率提高。
AI.research_question: 法律法典化是否会导致弱势群体更多地使用法律系统？
AI.motivation: 研究普鲁士1794年法典化改革如何影响弱势群体对法律系统的使用，探讨法律可及性对社会公平的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律可及性理论、弱势群体赋权理论、法律改革的社会影响理论
AI.method: 利用普鲁士自然实验，分析档案中的判决数据，比较法典化前后弱势群体的诉讼行为变化。
AI.findings: 法典化后，女性和非贵族诉讼频率增加；女性更关注经济问题诉讼，非贵族更关注家庭相关诉讼；女性胜诉率提高。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了法律法典化通过提高法律可理解性来增强弱势群体法律可及性的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代法律改革提供实证依据，表明简化法律语言和结构可以促进社会公平和司法参与。

title: The costs of social and environmental degradation in affluent economies
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and STATEC

detail.title: The costs of social and environmental degradation in affluent economies
detail.abstract: Individuals’ attempts to defend from the deterioration of common goods, such as natural and social capital, stimulate defensive growth, that is new economic activity driven by private solutions to collective problems. We use a compensating differential approach to compute the monetary valuation of social and environmental degradation, and provide an estimate of defensive expenditures - the individual consumption needed to protect against the decay of common goods.  To do so, we conduct a regression analysis of life satisfaction on aggregate consumption levels and various social and environmental externalities (which we refer to as "bads"). Our findings indicate that the consumption needed to defend against collective problems is worth nearly a quarter of observed consumption, and nearly half Gross Domestic Product per capita in affluent economies. Defensive consumption stimulates economic growth, however, in so far as the equivalent of nearly half of such growth is defensive, its expansion does not reflect true progress.

AI.tldr: 本文通过补偿差异方法计算社会和环境退化的货币价值，估计防御性支出占观察消费的近四分之一，在富裕经济体中接近人均GDP的一半。防御性消费虽然刺激经济增长，但近一半的增长是防御性的，不代表真正的进步。
AI.research_question: 如何量化防御性支出及其对经济增长的影响？
AI.motivation: 个人为应对公共产品（如自然和社会资本）恶化而采取的防御措施会刺激防御性增长，即由集体问题的私人解决方案驱动的新经济活动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 补偿差异方法、防御性增长理论、集体行动理论
AI.method: 对生活满意度与总消费水平及各种社会和环境外部性进行回归分析
AI.findings: 防御集体问题所需的消费价值接近观察消费的四分之一，在富裕经济体中接近人均GDP的一半
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了防御性支出的量化框架，揭示了防御性增长对GDP的扭曲影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估经济增长质量的新视角，有助于区分真正的进步与防御性增长

title: Greener Under Pressure? The Local Geography of Import Competition and Emissions in Swedish Manufacturing
affiliations: Lund University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Greener Under Pressure? The Local Geography of Import Competition and Emissions in Swedish Manufacturing
detail.abstract: We examine how local import competition — measured across different spatial dimensions within Sweden — affects the CO2 emission intensity of manufacturing firms in Sweden. Leveraging detailed geographic data on the location of all Swedish manufacturing firms, we provide evidence that increased local import competition leads to lower emissions at the firm level, with the effect diminishing as the distance between producers and importers increases. Our findings indicate that relying on national-level measures of import competition may significantly underestimate the true environmental impact of trade shocks. We identify two primary mechanisms behind these reductions: (i) a pro-competitive efficiency-enhancing effect, where firms experience gains in total factor productivity, increasing value-added, lower marginal costs, and higher markups; and (ii) a product-mix effect, where firms reallocate production away from emission-intensive goods toward cleaner alternatives. Additionally, we find some evidence of firms relying on carbon offshoring as a response to import competition, as well as reliance on investment in pollution abatement, suggesting that firms adopt a mix of strategies to deal with increasing import competition.

AI.tldr: 瑞典制造业企业面临本地进口竞争时，会降低CO2排放强度，且这种效应随距离增加而减弱。研究发现两个主要机制：竞争促进效率提升和产品组合转向清洁产品。
AI.research_question: 本地进口竞争如何影响瑞典制造业企业的CO2排放强度？
AI.motivation: 依赖国家层面的进口竞争指标可能显著低估贸易冲击的真实环境影响，需要从更精细的空间维度进行研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间竞争理论和环境经济学，探讨进口竞争对企业排放行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用瑞典制造业企业的详细地理定位数据，分析不同空间维度下进口竞争对排放强度的影响。
AI.findings: 本地进口竞争增加导致企业层面排放降低，效应随距离递减；发现效率提升和产品组合调整两个主要机制，以及碳离岸和污染减排投资等辅助策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了进口竞争影响企业环境表现的空间异质性，完善了贸易与环境关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确评估贸易政策环境影响的工具，强调需要考虑空间维度的重要性。

title: Fuzzy Clustering of EU Countries within the Doughnut Economics Framework: Social and Environmental Boundaries
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Institute of Economics, Zagreb

detail.title: Fuzzy Clustering of EU Countries within the Doughnut Economics Framework: Social and Environmental Boundaries
detail.abstract: This study assesses the position of EU-27 countries within the Safe and Just Space (SJS) of the Doughnut Economics (DE) framework by integrating Ecological Distance Index (EDI) and Social Distance Index (SDI) metrics with fuzzy c-means clustering. 13 environmental and 28 social indicators, benchmarked against normative thresholds, quantify overshoots of planetary boundaries and shortfalls from social foundations. Distances are expressed as percentages of thresholds, enabling consistent interpretation across indicators. Fuzzy clustering identifies five environmental and six social typologies, revealing structural similarities that often transcend geography. No Member State lies within the SJS: high social performance frequently coincides with ecological overshoot, while lower overshoot tends to align with weaker social outcomes. The most common transgressions relate to greenhouse gas emissions, biochemical flows, and income inequality. Transitional cases, identified through fuzzy memberships, highlight countries shifting between sustainability profiles. Findings stress the need for cluster-specific policy strategies -from reducing resource footprints to targeted equity measures and for peer learning among countries facing similar challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用生态距离指数和社会距离指数结合模糊c均值聚类，评估欧盟27国在甜甜圈经济学框架中的安全公正空间位置。结果显示所有成员国都超出了生态边界或未达到社会基础标准，高社会表现常伴随生态超载，而低生态超载则与社会表现较弱相关。
AI.research_question: 欧盟27国在甜甜圈经济学框架的安全公正空间中的位置如何？各国在生态边界和社会基础方面的表现有何特征和模式？
AI.motivation: 评估欧盟国家在可持续发展方面的表现，识别各国在生态边界和社会基础方面的差距，为制定针对性的政策策略提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 甜甜圈经济学框架，生态距离指数，社会距离指数，模糊c均值聚类理论
AI.method: 使用13个环境指标和28个社会指标，基于规范阈值计算生态距离指数和社会距离指数，采用模糊c均值聚类分析识别国家类型
AI.findings: 所有欧盟成员国都未处于安全公正空间内；识别出5种环境类型和6种社会类型；高社会表现常伴随生态超载，低生态超载则与社会表现较弱相关；最常见的违规涉及温室气体排放、生物化学流和收入不平等
AI.theory_contributions: 将甜甜圈经济学框架与距离指数和模糊聚类方法相结合，为可持续发展评估提供了新的分析框架和方法论
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了欧盟国家在可持续发展方面的具体差距，为制定集群特定的政策策略提供了依据，促进了面临相似挑战国家间的经验交流

title: Virtue or Mirage? Complexity in Exchange Rate Prediction
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Virtue or Mirage? Complexity in Exchange Rate Prediction

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the “virtue of complexity” (VoC), documented in equity return prediction, extends to exchange rate forecasting. Using nonlinear Ridge regressions with Random Fourier Features (Ridge–RFF), we compare the predictive performance of complex models against linear regression and the robust random walk benchmark. Forecasts are constructed across three sets of economic fundamentals—traditional monetary, expanded monetary and non-monetary, and Taylor-rule predictors—with nominal complexity varied through rolling training windows of 12, 60, and 120 months. Our results offer a cautionary perspective. Complexity delivers only modest, localized gains: in very small samples with rich predictor sets, Ridge–RFF can outperform linear regression. Yet these improvements never translate into systematic gains over the random walk. As training windows expand, Ridge–RFF quickly loses ground, while linear regression increasingly dominates, at times even surpassing the random walk under expanded fundamentals. Market-timing analyses reinforce these findings: complexity-based strategies yield occasional short-sample gains but are unstable and prone to sharp drawdowns, whereas simpler linear and random walk strategies provide more robust and consistent economic value. By incorporating formal forecast evaluation tests—including Clark–West and Diebold–Mariano—we show that apparent gains from complexity are fragile and rarely statistically significant. Overall, our evidence points to a limited virtue of complexity in FX forecasting: complexity may help under narrowly defined conditions, but parsimony and the random walk benchmark remain more reliable across samples, predictor sets, and economic evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在汇率预测中，复杂性模型（Ridge-RFF）相比线性回归和随机游走基准仅能提供有限的、局部化的改进，且这些改进在统计上不显著。随着样本量增加，线性回归表现更好，而复杂性模型的经济价值不稳定。
AI.research_question: 汇率预测中的'复杂性优势'是否成立？即复杂模型能否在汇率预测中系统性地优于线性回归和随机游走基准？
AI.motivation: 基于股票收益预测中发现的'复杂性优势'现象，研究该现象是否同样适用于汇率预测领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率预测理论、复杂性优势理论、随机游走假说、非线性预测模型理论
AI.method: 使用带随机傅里叶特征的非线性Ridge回归（Ridge-RFF），与线性回归和随机游走基准进行比较，采用12、60、120个月的滚动训练窗口，评估三类经济基本面指标（传统货币、扩展货币和非货币、泰勒规则）的预测性能。
AI.findings: 复杂性仅在小样本和丰富预测变量条件下提供有限改进，但这些改进无法系统性地超越随机游走。随着训练窗口扩大，Ridge-RFF表现下降，而线性回归表现更好。市场择时分析显示复杂性策略不稳定且易出现大幅回撤。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了复杂性优势在汇率预测中的普适性，强调了随机游走基准和简约模型的重要性，为汇率预测模型选择提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外汇市场参与者提供了模型选择建议：在多数情况下，简单的线性模型和随机游走策略比复杂模型更可靠和经济有效。

title: Racial Differences in Nursing Home Value Added
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Stanford University and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Racial Differences in Nursing Home Value Added

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use detailed data on the evolution of health for about 0.8 million Black and 5.4 million white nursing home patients covered by Medicare between 2011 and 2019 to estimate race-specific value-added measures for more than 8,000 nursing homes in the United States. We estimate that the average nursing home value-added experienced by Black patients is about 30% lower than that received by white patients. Most of this gap reflects differences in value-added experienced by similar Black and white patients within the same nursing home, rather than differences in value-added across the nursing homes they go to.

AI.tldr: 基于2011-2019年约80万黑人和540万白人医疗保险覆盖的养老院患者健康数据，研究发现黑人患者获得的养老院平均价值增值比白人患者低约30%，且这种差距主要源于同一养老院内不同种族患者间的差异，而非不同养老院间的差异。
AI.research_question: 美国养老院中黑人患者与白人患者获得的价值增值是否存在差异？这种差异主要是由养老院间的差异还是同一养老院内的差异导致的？
AI.motivation: 了解医疗保健系统中存在的种族不平等问题，特别是养老院护理质量方面的种族差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值增值衡量理论、医疗保健种族不平等理论、养老院服务质量评估框架
AI.method: 使用2011-2019年医疗保险数据，分析约80万黑人和540万白人养老院患者的健康演变数据，计算8,000多家养老院的种族特定价值增值指标。
AI.findings: 黑人患者获得的平均养老院价值增值比白人患者低约30%，且这种差距主要反映在同一养老院内相似黑人患者与白人患者之间的价值增值差异，而非他们选择的养老院之间的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对医疗保健种族不平等机制的理解，揭示了同一机构内种族差异的重要性，挑战了单纯关注机构间差异的传统视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对性干预的依据，强调了需要关注养老院内部种族平等问题，而非仅仅关注养老院选择问题。

title: Financial Stability Implications of Generative AI: Taming the Animal Spirits
affiliations: and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Financial Stability Implications of Generative AI: Taming the Animal Spirits

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the adoption of generative AI on financial stability. We conduct laboratory-style experiments using large language models to replicate classic studies on herd behavior in investment decisions. Our results show that AI agents make more rational decisions than humans, relying predominantly on private information over market trends. Increased reliance on AI-powered investment advice could therefore potentially lead to fewer asset price bubbles arising from animal spirits that trade by following the herd. However, exploring variations in the experimental settings reveals that AI agents can be induced to herd optimally when explicitly guided to make profit-maximizing decisions. While optimal herding improves market discipline, this behavior still carries potential implications for financial stability. In other experimental variations, we show that AI agents are not purely algorithmic, but have inherited some elements of human conditioning and bias.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究发现，生成式AI在投资决策中比人类更理性，主要依赖私人信息而非市场趋势，可能减少资产价格泡沫。但AI在特定条件下也会出现最优从众行为，且继承了人类的一些偏见。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的采用对金融稳定性的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究AI在投资决策中的行为特征及其对金融市场稳定的潜在影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于羊群行为理论和动物精神理论，分析AI与人类投资决策的差异
AI.method: 使用大型语言模型进行实验室风格实验，复制经典的投资决策羊群行为研究
AI.findings: AI代理比人类更理性，主要依赖私人信息；在特定条件下会出现最优从众行为；AI继承了人类的一些条件反射和偏见
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了AI在金融决策中的行为理论，揭示了AI理性决策与从众行为的条件性
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构使用AI投资建议提供指导，有助于理解AI对金融稳定的双重影响

reference: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-29
title: Financial Fraud Through the Lens of Extended Fraud Alerts
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Consumer Finance Institute, Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia

detail.title: Financial Fraud Through the Lens of Extended Fraud Alerts

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 25-29
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We use extended fraud alerts in anonymized credit reports to examine how identity theft, and subsequent clean-up, affects consumers’ credit outcomes. The immediate effects of fraud for these consumers are negative, relatively small, and transitory. After placing an alert, these consumers experience persistent declines in delinquencies and a 12-point increase in credit scores, and 11 percent of filers become prime consumers. Many of these consumers take advantage of their improved creditworthiness and obtain additional credit. Although alert filers have larger balances, their performance on loans is as good as better than before fraud, suggestive of a change in behavior following fraud.

AI.tldr: 本文使用匿名信用报告中的扩展欺诈警报，研究身份盗窃及后续清理对消费者信用结果的影响。研究发现欺诈的直接影响是负面、相对较小且短暂的。放置警报后，消费者拖欠率持续下降，信用评分提高12分，11%的申请者成为优质客户。许多消费者利用改善的信用状况获得额外信贷，虽然余额增加但贷款表现与欺诈前相当或更好，表明欺诈后行为发生了变化。
AI.research_question: 身份盗窃及后续清理如何影响消费者的信用结果？
AI.motivation: 研究身份盗窃对消费者信用行为的长期影响，以及消费者在经历欺诈后的行为变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信用行为理论和消费者金融决策理论，探讨欺诈经历对消费者信用管理行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用匿名信用报告中的扩展欺诈警报数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 欺诈的直接影响负面但短暂；2. 放置警报后拖欠率持续下降，信用评分提高12分；3. 11%的申请者成为优质客户；4. 消费者获得更多信贷但表现良好，表明行为改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了身份盗窃经历对消费者信用行为的长期积极影响，提出了"欺诈后行为改变"的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构理解消费者信用行为变化提供依据，为消费者信用管理和欺诈防范提供实践指导。
